answers.question: Subtracting earned revenue from gross cost gives what subtotal, and after the gain or loss from changes in assumptions, what net cost?
answers.text:
Subtracting earned revenue from gross cost yields a subtotal known as net cost before adjustments. After adjusting this figure by the (gain)/loss from changes in assumptions regarding pensions and other benefits, the final result is the Net Cost.

The Treasury Financial Statements of the United States Government FY2023 describe these components explicitly:

Gross Cost: Defined as the total cost of providing federal goods and services, excluding gains or losses from changes in assumptions and before considering related exchange revenue[^1].

Earned Revenue: Defined as exchange revenue resulting from the government providing goods and services to the public at a price[^2].

(Gain)/Loss from Changes in Assumptions: Defined as the gain or loss from changes in long-term assumptions used to measure liabilities for federal civilian and military employee pensions, OPEB, and ORB[^3].

Net Cost: Computed by subtracting earned revenue from gross cost, then adjusting that result by the (gain)/loss from changes in assumptions[^4].

This process ensures that the final Net Cost accurately reflects the total cost of operations for each entity at the government-wide level, including reallocations of intra-governmental costs and imputed costs related to benefits like post-retirement health care.

[^5] Treasury Financial Statements of the United States Government FY2023, page 1: "Net cost—is computed by subtracting earned revenue from gross cost, adjusted by the (gain)/loss from changes in assumptions."

sustainability financial statements, and the notes represent basic information that is deemed essential for the consolidated
financial statements to be presented in conformity with GAAP.
ACCRUAL-BASED FINANCIAL STATEMENTS

owes (liabilities) at the end of the year, what came in (revenues) and what went out (net costs) during the year, and how
accrual-based net operating costs of the federal government reconcile to the budget deficit and changes in its cash balance
during the year. The following sections discuss each of the accrual-based financial statements.
Statements of Net Cost
These statements present the net cost of the government operations for FYs 2023 and 2022. Costs and earned revenues
are categorized on the Statement of Net Cost by significant entity, providing greater accountability by showing the
relationship of the entities’ net cost to the government-wide net cost. Costs and earned revenues are presented in this

the Budget is by entity.

The Statements of Net Cost contain the following four components:
• Gross cost—is the total cost of providing federal goods and services, excluding (gain)/loss from changes in
assumptions and before considering related exchange revenue. The gross costs are the amounts reported by each
entity, adjusted to reflect certain cost assignments made on a cause-and-effect or other reasonable basis (see
discussion below).
• Earned revenue—is exchange revenue resulting from the government providing goods and services to the public at a
price.
• (Gain)/loss from changes in assumptions—is the gain or loss from changes in long-term assumptions used to
measure the liabilities reported for federal civilian and military employee pensions, OPEB, and ORB, including
veterans’ compensation.
• Net cost—is computed by subtracting earned revenue from gross cost, adjusted by the (gain)/loss from changes in
assumptions.
Individual entity net cost amounts will differ from the entity’s financial statements primarily because of the elimination
of intra-governmental activity and the subsequent reallocation of certain costs to individual entities at the government-wide
level. While intra-governmental costs are eliminated from the face of the financial statements, the consolidated Statements of
Net Cost is intended to show the total cost for each entity, therefore, reallocations are completed at the government-wide

全年全国居民⼈均消费⽀出26796元，⽐上年增长9.2%，扣除价格因素，实际增长9.0%。其中，⼈均服务性消费⽀出[59]12114元，⽐上年增长14.4%，占居民⼈均消费⽀出⽐重为45.2%。按常住地分，城镇居民⼈均消费⽀出32994元，增长8.6%，扣除价格因素，实际增长8.3%；农村居民⼈均消费⽀出18175元，增长9.3%，扣除价格因素，实际增长9.2%。全国居民恩格尔系数为29.8%，其中城镇为28.8%，农村为32.4%。

年末全国参加城镇职⼯基本养⽼保险⼈数52121万⼈，⽐上年末增加1766万⼈。参加城乡居民基本养⽼保险⼈数54522万⼈，减少430万⼈。参加基本医疗保险⼈数[60]133387万⼈，其中参加职⼯基本医疗保险⼈数37094万⼈，参加城乡居民基本医疗保险⼈数96293万⼈。参加失业保险⼈数24373万⼈，增加566万⼈。领取失业保险⾦⼈数352万⼈。参加⼯伤保险⼈数30170万⼈，增加1054万⼈。参加⽣育保险⼈数24907万⼈。年末全国共有664万⼈享受城市最低⽣活保障，3399万⼈享受农村最低⽣活保障，435万⼈享受农村特困⼈员[61]救助供养，全年临时救助[62]742万⼈次。全年领取国家定期抚恤⾦、定期⽣活补助⾦的退役军⼈和其他优抚对象834万⼈。
年末全国共有各类提供住宿的民政服务机构4.4万个，其中养⽼机构4.1万个，⼉童福利和救助保护机构971个。民政服务床位[63]846.3万张，其中养⽼服务床位820.1万张，⼉童福利和救助保护机构床位9.8万张。
